2609.11393.title: Beyond Confidence: Stability-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for LLM Reasoning
2609.11393.paper_summary: Test-time adaptation has emerged as a lightweight alternative to costly post-training for improving the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) on downstream tasks. Predictive entropy provides a model-derived signal for such adaptation, guiding models toward higher-confidence reasoning states without external verifiers or reward models. However, higher confidence does not necessarily imply correctness, as LLMs may remain highly confident along incorrect reasoning trajectories. We observe that high-confidence reasoning is more likely to be correct when confidence remains stable under local perturbations. Based on this observation, we propose Test-Time Adaptation via Stability-Aware Confidence Optimization (TASCO), a framework that incorporates local stability into confidence-based test-time adaptation while keeping the LLM frozen. TASCO operationalizes local stability by optimizing a lightweight task-level prefix under two alternative perturbation strategies: Random Perturbation promotes distributional stability across trajectories induced by nearby perturbed prefixes, whereas Sharpness-Aware Perturbation targets worst-case local sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that TASCO improves reasoning accuracy and token efficiency across diverse LLMs and reasoning benchmarks, while behavioral analyses show that it maintains stable confidence under local perturbations without prematurely concentrating the model's predictive distribution.
2609.11393.paper_summary_zh: 測試時適應已成為一種輕量級的替代方案，用於改善大型語言模型（LLMs）在下游任務上的推理能力，取代昂貴的後訓練方法。預測熵提供了一種模型衍生的信號，用於此類適應，引導模型朝向更高信心的推理狀態，而無需外部驗證者或獎勵模型。然而，更高的信心並不一定意味著正確性，因為LLMs可能在錯誤的推理路徑上仍然保持高度的信心。我們觀察到，當信心在局部擾動下保持穩定時，高信心的推理更有可能是正確的。基於這一觀察，我們提出了通過穩定性感知信心優化的測試時適應（TASCO），這是一個將局部穩定性納入基於信心的測試時適應的框架，同時保持LLM不變。TASCO通過在兩種替代擾動策略下優化輕量級任務級前綴來實現局部穩定性：隨機擾動促進由附近擾動前綴引起的路徑之間的分佈穩定性，而敏感性感知擾動則針對最壞情況的局部敏感性。實驗表明，TASCO在不同的LLMs和推理基準上提高了推理準確性和標記效率，而行為分析顯示它在局部擾動下保持穩定的信心，而不會過早地集中模型的預測分佈。
